content: Individual named-member admissibility differs from admissibility after finite linear combination. The example p6-(7/2)p4 cancels the next boundary residual although each summand lies outside Hc4. A fixed right inverse of the four-trace map corrects polynomial approximations and gives a graph core. This provides the independent route to 0<=s<7/2 density; it does not extend deleted-family classifications or certify uniform-c/basis claims. Local Lean covers real algebra, not the spectral/Sobolev argument.
locator: Sixth-round repaired proof and independent findings
